WHAT IT MEANS IN A FIGHT
· 4WD: all 1.86 kg sits on driven tyres → grip push ≈ 16.4 N at μ 0.9
· v4.3 had 11.3 N (83 % of 1.53 kg on 2 tyres): ≈ 45 % more push
· each motor must give ≥ 0.27 N·m to spin all four tyres (JGB37-520 stall is above that)
· CG 37 mm up, +18 mm from the wheelbase centre: front tyres a bit heavier
· no weight limit: a 300–500 g steel ballast plate fits under the battery (+2.6–4.4 N)
